entities.summary: Prajogo Pangestu, born Phang Djoen Phen is an Indonesian billionaire, business magnate, investor, and philanthropist. He is the founder of the Indonesian conglomerate Barito Pacific Group, which engages in forestry, plantations, oil and gas, coal, gold mining, and geothermal energy. With a net worth of USD$43.41 billion, he is the wealthiest person in Southeast Asia.
